_comment: Terrain defence stars. The game DISPLAYS this as 'Def' when you highlight a
tile, so it is directly observable and never needed to be inferred from
damage. Every value here was read off that display in-game.
Cross-check worth recording: calibration independently derived road=0,
plains=1 and mountain=4 from damage observations alone, before we knew the
display existed. All three matched. The two routes share no inputs, so that
is a genuine confirmation of the damage model rather than a tautology.
Aliases are included so recordings can use whichever word the player types.
Missile silo is NOT listed: its Def has not been read yet, and it stays
absent rather than guessed. Anything absent remains a free parameter in

provenance.method: read from the in-game Def display
